executiveSummary: www.unionmedia-lb.com presents a moderate external attack surface. This assessment identified 4 findings (0 Critical, 0 High, 1 Medium, 2 Low, 1 Info) using the Block08 non-mutating toolkit. 8 controls were verified as correctly implemented. Primary gaps: content-security-policy not set; no dns caa record on www.unionmedia-lb.com; no security.txt vulnerability-disclosure contact. Closing the items below moves the deployment toward a best-in-class public posture.

findings.title: Content-Security-Policy not set
findings.evidence: No Content-Security-Policy header on https://www.unionmedia-lb.com/. Browsers cannot restrict script, frame, or object loading.
findings.recommendation: Ship a strict CSP with nonce-based script-src, object-src 'none', and frame-ancestors.

findings.title: No DNS CAA record on www.unionmedia-lb.com
findings.evidence: dig CAA www.unionmedia-lb.com returned no records. Any public CA may issue a certificate for this domain, widening the mis-issuance surface.
findings.recommendation: Publish a DNS CAA record pinning issuance to the CAs actually used (e.g. Let's Encrypt / your CDN CA) with an iodef contact.

findings.title: No security.txt vulnerability-disclosure contact
findings.evidence: /.well-known/security.txt returned HTTP 404. Researchers have no standard channel to report issues.
findings.recommendation: Publish /.well-known/security.txt (RFC 9116) with Contact, Encryption, Policy and Expires fields.

findings.title: Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy not set
findings.evidence: COOP/COEP/CORP not present. Cross-origin isolation is not enabled.
findings.recommendation: Consider 'Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin' where compatible with third-party frames.

controls.title: No hard secrets detected in client bundles
controls.detail: Scanned 8 script(s) for sk_live/AKIA/AIza/PEM/github token patterns, none found.

controls.title: Cloudflare WAF/CDN fronts the origin
controls.detail: server/cf-ray present. Origin IP is masked at the edge.

controls.title: HTTP upgrades to HTTPS
controls.detail: Plain HTTP requests redirect to HTTPS.

scope.rules: External black-box · non-destructive (strictly non-mutating). No denial-of-service, no brute force, no configuration changes, no data mutation. Every request is rate-limited and identified via a dedicated audit User-Agent.
scope.methodology: OWASP WSTG v4.2 · PTES · NIST SP 800-115. Information gathering, configuration & deployment, transport, and client-side controls.

roadmap: Ship the response-header hardening set (HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy) at the edge in a single change.
Remove disclosure surface: drop X-Powered-By, publish /.well-known/security.txt, and add a DNS CAA record.
Disable legacy TLS 1.0/1.1 if offered and require TLS 1.2+.
Re-run this suite after remediation for a clean baseline suitable for stakeholder distribution.
assurance: Block08 Security Audits conducted this automated external assessment of www.unionmedia-lb.com on the date recorded herein, following a disciplined, evidence-driven methodology. Every finding was produced by the Block08 toolkit from live tool output (curl, openssl, dig) and a deterministic rule engine, not a language model. Testing was strictly non-mutating. Security testing cannot prove the absence of all vulnerabilities; findings are limited to the observable unauthenticated surface under the stated rules of engagement.
